object.attr: derived: CF-V51, review Q31. git's merge works the base out over each common ancestor, so its recorded base doesn't make a change on both sides read as one-sided. Chosen by the team lead over the analysis's D-V34. Open question. Replaces MELLON-VER-SRS-310.
object.description: When ours and theirs have more than one merge base, Mellon shall merge each conflicting file from the base content that git recorded in the index for the file.
